I am 61 years old, been on this land 45 years. No school, but my hands know cotton. This year same as last year, why change when it works.

My 9 mu, all cotton. I plant improved seed, the kind the dealer in town sells — most neighbors buy the same, Bt kind, bollworm don't eat it so bad. One bag does about 1 mu for me.

Before planting I spread manure from my chickens and some I buy, then plough the field with the tractor man — he charge me by mu. After plough I put base fertilizer, the compound one, 50 kg bag, I use 2 bags for every 3 mu, so about one and a half bag per mu, that's 50 kg compound per mu roughly. Then when cotton start squaring I top-dress with urea, one bag 50 kg I spread over 3 mu, so about 17 kg urea per mu — nitrogen side that give me maybe 20 kg N from compound plus 8 from urea, call it 28 kg N. Phosphorus from compound about 8, potash about 8. I don't buy extra potash, too much money.

Water — I got the well. Cotton I water maybe 4 times: after planting if dry, at squaring, at flowering, at boll time. If rain come I skip one.

Pest — cotton always got trouble. Aphid early, then bollworm, then red spider in hot time. I spray 5 times usually, mix what the shop tell me. Bt seed help but still must spray.

Plough the land proper before planting, not rotary — deep plough every year, my father did same.

Yield — good year I get 250 kg seed cotton per mu, bad year 200. I plan for 230.
